name: svg-french-press-mistral-large-4-0-s3-r2
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 1000" width="640" height="1000">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f2f4f6"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#c3c9cf"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#8d939a"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#d7dbdf"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="plastic" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#585858"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#2e2e2e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#151515"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="metal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef1f4"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#a9afb6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="mesh" width="5" height="5" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0,0 L5,5 M5,0 L0,5" stroke="#8a9199" stroke-width="0.7" fill="none"/>
    </pattern>
    <clipPath id="carafeClip">
      <path d="M200,720 L200,928 Q200,950 222,950 L378,950 Q400,950 400,928 L400,720 Z"/>
    </clipPath>
    <clipPath id="plateClip">
      <ellipse cx="300" cy="658" rx="95" ry="18"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect width="640" height="1000" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <text x="320" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="21" font-weight="bold" fill="#222">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>

  <!-- assembly axis -->
  <line x1="300" y1="52" x2="300" y2="976" stroke="#b8b8b8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 7"/>

  <!-- 1. knob -->
  <rect x="240" y="60" width="120" height="42" rx="17" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#0d0d0d" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="250" y="66" width="100" height="9" rx="4.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.14"/>
  <rect x="287" y="99" width="26" height="11" rx="4" fill="#1c1c1c"/>

  <!-- 2. plunger rod -->
  <rect x="295" y="108" width="10" height="232" rx="5" fill="url(#steel)" stroke="#7c8288" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 3. lid -->
  <rect x="175" y="378" width="250" height="20" fill="#2a2a2a"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="398" rx="125" ry="20" fill="#202020"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="378" rx="125" ry="20" fill="url(#plastic)" stroke="#0d0d0d" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="378" rx="10" ry="4.5" fill="#0a0a0a"/>
  <ellipse cx="243" cy="375" rx="13" ry="5" fill="#0a0a0a" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- 4. filter spring -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="5">
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="448" rx="70" ry="10"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="464" rx="70" ry="10"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="480" rx="70" ry="10"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="496" rx="70" ry="10"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="512" rx="70" ry="10"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 5. mesh filter disc -->
  <rect x="205" y="578" width="190" height="12" fill="#a6acb2"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="590" rx="95" ry="18" fill="#8f959b"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="578" rx="95" ry="18" fill="#dfe3e7"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="578" rx="95" ry="18" fill="url(#mesh)"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="578" rx="95" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#767c83" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="578" rx="86" ry="15" fill="none" stroke="#9aa0a6" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="578" rx="10" ry="4" fill="#8f959b" stroke="#6d7378" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 6. cross plate -->
  <rect x="205" y="658" width="190" height="12" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="670" rx="95" ry="18" fill="#878d93"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="658" rx="95" ry="18" fill="url(#metal)" stroke="#767c83" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#plateClip)">
    <rect x="291" y="636" width="18" height="44" fill="#b9bfc5" stroke="#767c83" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="203" y="649" width="194" height="18" fill="#b9bfc5" stroke="#767c83" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <g fill="#6d7378">
      <circle cx="360.6" cy="664.5" r="2.6"/>
      <circle cx="335" cy="669.3" r="2.6"/>
      <circle cx="265" cy="669.3" r="2.6"/>
      <circle cx="239.4" cy="664.5" r="2.6"/>
      <circle cx="239.4" cy="651.5" r="2.6"/>
      <circle cx="265" cy="646.7" r="2.6"/>
      <circle cx="335" cy="646.7" r="2.6"/>
      <circle cx="360.6" cy="651.5" r="2.6"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="658" rx="10" ry="4" fill="#8f959b" stroke="#6d7378" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- 7. glass carafe -->
  <g transform="translate(0,10)">
  <path d="M195,716 L195,928 Q195,955 222,955 L378,955 Q405,955 405,928 L405,716 Z" fill="#d8ebf5" opacity="0.4"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#carafeClip)">
    <rect x="198" y="802" width="204" height="150" fill="#6f4a2d" opacity="0.85"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="802" rx="99" ry="10" fill="#7d5636"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="203" y="924" width="194" height="26" rx="9" fill="#cfe2ee" opacity="0.8" stroke="#7f98a8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M195,716 L195,928 Q195,955 222,955 L378,955 Q405,955 405,928 L405,716" fill="none" stroke="#7f98a8" stroke-width="3"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="716" rx="105" ry="13" fill="#b9d2e2" opacity="0.85"/>
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="716" rx="105" ry="13" fill="none" stroke="#7f98a8" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d="M403,782 C462,782 480,806 480,848 C480,892 460,914 403,914" fill="none" stroke="#7f98a8" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M403,782 C462,782 480,806 480,848 C480,892 460,914 403,914" fill="none" stroke="#d8ebf5" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.55"/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d="M196,713 C182,700 170,695 160,699 C169,709 183,718 199,723 Z" fill="#d8ebf5" opacity="0.55" stroke="#7f98a8" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <rect x="206" y="732" width="8" height="190" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.35"/>
  </g>

  <!-- labels -->
  <g stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1">
    <line x1="364" y1="80" x2="452" y2="80"/>
    <line x1="307" y1="210" x2="452" y2="210"/>
    <line x1="427" y1="388" x2="452" y2="388"/>
    <line x1="372" y1="480" x2="452" y2="480"/>
    <line x1="397" y1="584" x2="452" y2="584"/>
    <line x1="397" y1="664" x2="452" y2="664"/>
    <line x1="404" y1="955" x2="452" y2="955"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#999999">
    <circle cx="364" cy="80" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="307" cy="210" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="427" cy="388" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="372" cy="480" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="397" cy="584" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="397" cy="664" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="404" cy="955" r="2"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#333333">
    <text x="460" y="85"><tspan font-weight="bold">1</tspan><tspan dx="8">Knob</tspan></text>
    <text x="460" y="215"><tspan font-weight="bold">2</tspan><tspan dx="8">Plunger rod</tspan></text>
    <text x="460" y="393"><tspan font-weight="bold">3</tspan><tspan dx="8">Lid</tspan></text>
    <text x="460" y="485"><tspan font-weight="bold">4</tspan><tspan dx="8">Filter spring</tspan></text>
    <text x="460" y="589"><tspan font-weight="bold">5</tspan><tspan dx="8">Mesh filter</tspan></text>
    <text x="460" y="669"><tspan font-weight="bold">6</tspan><tspan dx="8">Cross plate</tspan></text>
    <text x="460" y="960"><tspan font-weight="bold">7</tspan><tspan dx="8">Glass carafe</tspan></text>
  </g>

  <text x="320" y="984" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-style="italic" fill="#777777">Plunger filter = spring + mesh + cross plate (three-piece design)</text>
</svg>
